## The system

A case is a prediction problem with a decision attached. Name the decision first.

## Worked example

Two hundred customers, one churn flag each. The decision is who gets a call.

## Why it works

A metric that ignores the cost of a call picks the wrong customers.

## Signal vs. noise

The exact model family matters less than the metric and the threshold.

## Where it breaks

When the positive class is rare, accuracy looks fine while nothing is caught.

## Interview angle

Frame, ask, state the metric, then defend the model in two sentences.

## Connections

Links to confusion matrices and threshold choice.
